# Multi-scale approach to dependence-aware cointegration / relative-value analysis

A concept shared by **5** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #6,144. The CSV rates every member: *Low confidence — reconstructed from the algorithm title; executable rules and source support are not established.* None is implemented in volatility-ai.

## Description

Proposed multi-scale approach to dependence-aware cointegration / relative-value analysis: Model joint and tail dependence among assets and assess whether a stable long-run spread exists before considering relative-value positions. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
